text: {"summary":"Services are intermittently failing DNS resolution of other services","likely_cause":"CoreDNS add‑on or its Service (kube-dns) is experiencing issues (e.g., mis‑configured resolv.conf, forwarding loop with systemd‑resolved, or nameserver limit) causing DNS queries to fail","confidence":"medium","next_action":"kubectl exec -ti dnsutils -- cat /etc/resolv.conf && verify nameserver/search path; kubectl exec -ti dnsutils -- nslookup kubernetes.default to confirm CoreDNS response; kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns && kubectl logs <coredns-pod> for errors; ensure node resolv.conf points to the correct CoreDNS IP (use /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf if systemd-resolved) or set kubelet --resolv-conf flag; if 3‑nameserver limit is hit, deploy dnsmasq or adjust kubelet flag"}
